capabilities: Lint prose with deterministic craft rules and AI-tell detection
Generate persona-driven editorial feedback and critical manuscript analysis
Co-write drafts turn-by-turn with tool-calling, subagents, and context compaction
Manage typed lorebook entries with coverage-gap detection and a coach mode
Track manuscript metrics, writing goals, and strip image attachment metadata
disambiguation: Not a text generator; the README positions it as 'a thoughtful editor, not a text generator', centered on feedback and linting.
extras: Some feature details are deferred to an external wiki (AI-tell heuristics, context management, attachment metadata). The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Core linter, dashboard, and lorebook features work with no AI model or network access.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in tools for fiction-specific prose checking, editorial feedback, or manuscript-consistency tracking, and AI writing tools typically generate text rather than critique it.

relations.evidence: It runs locally by default (Ollama, or any OpenAI-compatible local server such as LM Studio)
